boundaries: Do not paste session cookies, OAuth codes, access tokens, node enrollment files, or Sites gateway credentials into a receiving chat or notebook.
MHTML may preserve rendered reference content. Treat it as potentially containing private page text; it is not a reusable authenticated session.
Do not rewrite old receipt hashes or fabricate branch mappings. Record an actual URL/reference change as a new revision.
No provider harvesting, file-move telemetry, session renewal, or cross-provider access is granted by this handoff.
